_comment: Exp 41c — RETURN TO FIRST PRINCIPLES, pre-registered run (founder-directed 2026-05-22). The controlled A/B that tests whether convergence is now reachable AND honest after the convergence-detector fixes + the runner-gate simplification. PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen before the run, no post-hoc tuning): convergence is decided by the original simple criteria with gamma demoted to a pure diagnostic. The hardened gamma conjunction gate is OFF. gamma stays a LOAD-BEARING convergence trigger (the founding decay-curve concept), NOT demoted: the gamma-alt path converges when EITHER gamma reaches gamma_alt_threshold=0.30 (the decay curve has topped out) OR there are gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit=3 consecutive rounds with zero novel CRITICAL findings (the complementary count measure, which also covers gamma's OLS slope-lag). The crucial change that makes gamma honest again is that it is now fed GENUINE settled, verifier-filtered novelty (runner change 2026-05-22), not raw noise — so on a sound module where genuine discovery stops, the genuine cumulative curve flattens and gamma RISES to its threshold and fires. gamma never BLOCKS convergence (telemetry-only for the state gate, max_rounds=12 <= gamma_telemetry_only_until=14), so a low gamma cannot make convergence impossible while a high gamma can trigger it — the trigger-not-blocker resolution. This keeps gamma load-bearing per the founder's standing ruling against gamma demotion. novel/critical novelty fed to the gate is the SETTLED, verifier-filtered series (runner change 2026-05-22), so 'no new discoveries' means 'no new GENUINE discoveries that survived reconciliation + the now-LIVE software specialist verifier'. Target: the CURRENT (fixed) bench/dm/_convergence.py. Expectation, per the founder's hypothesis: on a now-sound module the panel finds few/zero genuine criticals and converges cleanly in roughly 3-6 rounds, replicating Exp 37 (the last naturally-converged run, state-based, before the Exp 40 gamma-gate complications). Report BOTH directions: false-convergence-prevented AND true-convergence-preserved.

_convergence_criteria.description: FIRST-PRINCIPLES gate (hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is a LOAD-BEARING convergence trigger (the founding decay-curve concept, NOT demoted), fed GENUINE settled novelty. Converged iff EITHER (A) gamma >= gamma_alt_threshold (0.30) — the decay curve has topped out; OR (B) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit (3) consecutive rounds with zero novel CRITICAL findings on the settled, verifier-filtered series (the complementary count measure, covering gamma's OLS slope-lag); OR (C) the original state gate passes for consecutive_rounds_required (3) consecutive rounds (no new genuine findings beyond max_novel_findings, open-critical not increasing, not contested, not churning). gamma can TRIGGER convergence but never BLOCKS it (telemetry-only for the state gate), so a low gamma cannot make convergence impossible while a high gamma can fire it. Novel/critical counts are recomputed from the settled registry so verifier-rejected noise does not inflate them.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma>=0.30 (decay topped out, fed genuine novelty) OR 3 consecutive zero-novel-critical rounds (settled/genuine) OR state gate passes 3 consecutive rounds.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_pre_registration: Frozen 2026-05-22 before the run. Thresholds: gamma_alt_threshold=0.30 (gamma LOAD-BEARING as a convergence trigger, fed genuine settled novelty, but never a blocker), gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit=3, consecutive_rounds_required=3, earliest_stop_round=3. No tuning after results. Success = clean convergence (gamma-alt count path) on the now-sound module within the round budget, with the post-run HIL materiality review confirming no genuine critical was silenced (verifier false-negative check). Failure modes to report honestly: (a) does not converge (over-production persists / verifier-rejection lag) -> diagnose under cy; (b) converges but HIL finds a silenced genuine critical -> verifier too aggressive.
_plan_ref: Founder direction 2026-05-22: run steps 1-4, replicate Exp 37's clean convergence. See Experiment 41 Convergence Fix + Confer notes (2026-05-22). Runner-gate change: settled/genuine novelty feeds gamma + gate; gamma diagnostic; gamma-alt count path.
